units.en: In order to form ⟦0⟧, Latvia must take the national focus ⟦1⟧ to start progressing down their fascist path. From here, they can court the fascist Thunder Cross movement and its leader, Gustavs Celmiņš. This is a delicate balancing act, however, as if the Thunder Cross movement grows too powerful too fast, they will attempt to overthrow the government, which will cause the whole scheme to collapse in on itself and a civil war to erupt. Once Gustavs Celmiņš and the Thunder Cross are in power, peacefully or not, they can opt to do something very strange; namely, align themselves with ⟦2⟧ and adopt the mantle of Reichskommissariat Ostland and serve their german masters by occupying the Baltics, Belarus and perhaps more beyond that. This is rather strange, as it essentially involves Latvia taking advantage of german designs and ambitions for the area to form a nation of their own as a reward for loyalty; effectively establishing Gustavs Celmiņš and the Thunder Cross as the Quislings of Eastern Europe. That being said, Latvia does get to remain independent and not become a puppet of Germany, which opens up the possibility of establishing puppet states of your own to expand Ostland's realm further and later breaking free from Germany and becoming fully sovereign (similar to ⟦3⟧), allowing Ostland to evolve from a mere reichskommissariat and artifical invention to an undisputed reality and legitimate state in its own right.
Not to be confused with the Slavic Union, a formable nation available for ⟦0⟧

The Pan-Slavic Union is a formable nation, that can be formed by going down the ⟦0⟧ focus-path as the ⟦1⟧. After the successfull Second Russian Civil War and either deciding for the monarchist or the fascist path, the nation can do the focus ⟦2⟧. ⟦3⟧ gets events to annex ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧. After integrating the four nations and forming the Pan-Slavic Union, ⟦8⟧ can still create the Triple Entente with ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧ or join the Axis alongside the ⟦11⟧ and potentially ⟦12⟧.
Once the above decisions are completed, the Pan-Slavic Union can be declared.

The ⟦0⟧ is a formable nation that represents the Commonwealth that existed from 1569 until 1795 when it was partitioned by Russia, Prussia, and the Austrian Empire. Only ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ can form the ⟦3⟧. Poland may form the ⟦4⟧ or the ⟦5⟧ if it follows the ⟦6⟧ or ⟦7⟧ paths respectively. It uses the same decision as the regular "Re-form the Commonwealth" decision but Poland keeps its white color.
If ⟦0⟧ follows ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ Sub-branches, the following names for the country is available:

With the ⟦0⟧ DLC, the Commonwealth can also be formed via national focus as either Poland or Lithuania, if the appropriate monarchist path is chosen. Forming it this way only requires you to have the other nation as a subject, which is much easier than gaining 80% compliance.

After forming the Commonwealth this way, additional national focuses become available to expand the Commonwealth even further. Starting as Lithuania, the ⟦0⟧ focus will give cores on Estonia, which cannot be obtained if the Commonwealth is formed as Poland. The focus ⟦1⟧ is available to both, and requires conquering substantial land from both Germany and the Soviet Union, beyond even what the Commonwealth historically controlled. Completing this focus will grant cores on all German land east of the Oder, all of Ukraine and Belarus, Crimea, and several Russian states southwest of Moscow. Southern Bessarabia is also cored, but is not required for formation. The combined population of all the available Polish-Lithuanian cores at game start is just under 95 million.

⟦0⟧ is a variation of the Commonwealth formable only by Communist Poland by the ⟦1⟧ focus tree, through ⟦2⟧ down to the ⟦3⟧ focus. In addition to standard Commonwealth cores, Commonwealth of Socialist Republics also cores ⟦4⟧ states.

Variations of Poland that can't form Commonwealth through their respective focus branches (for example, ⟦0⟧), if holding ⟦1⟧ states with more than 80% compliance, can do it through the "Re-form the Commonwealth" decision, changing name, flag and colors to ⟦2⟧ and gaining all of its cores.

Representing Fascist ⟦0⟧'s greatest ambition and perhaps the mightiest empire Europe has ever known, the ⟦1⟧ came into existence as part of a long process starting in 509 BC when the Roman Kingdom was replaced by the Roman Republic which would then proceed to conquer all of Italy, France, Greece, Iberia, the Low Countries as well as parts of Anatolia, and North Africa until 27 BC when the Roman Republic became the Roman Empire. After that, the Roman Empire went on to conquer all of England and Wales, Egypt, all of the Balkans, the rest of Anatolia, all of the Levant, a large chunk of Mesopotamia as well as pushing the Roman borders further and further into continental Central and Eastern Europe. The Roman Empire existed until 395 AD, when it was divided into the Eastern- and Western Roman Empire. The Western Roman Empire collapsed in 476 AD while the Eastern Roman Empire (Also known as ⟦2⟧, which can be formed by ⟦3⟧) would go on to persist until its demise in 1453. The last remnants of the Byzantine Empire (and by extension the Roman Empire) were wiped out in 1461-1475.

Once the decision "Realize Roman Ambitions" is enacted and the Roman Empire formed, ⟦0⟧ will change its name to "Imperium Romanum", change its color to a scarlet red and adopt a Roman imperial flag. Along with that, all the territories listed above will become Italian (Roman) cores. If Benito Mussolini, Vittorio Emanuele III or Umberto II is in power when the New Roman Empire is formed, they will change their name to "Augustus Mussolini", "Augustus Vittorio Emanuele" or "Augustus Umberto" and their portrait will change to a version of him wearing a golden laurel wreath.
After the ⟦0⟧ has been formed, the following decisions become available. The decisions will give the ⟦1⟧ cores on the required states, however it will cost ⟦2⟧ and ⟦3⟧.
The ⟦0⟧ will share the same party as the ⟦1⟧.
⟦0⟧ represents the medieval Kalmar Union, a state of union between Denmark, Norway, and Sweden, which existed from 1397-1523.

⟦0⟧ is the historical founding nation, as ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧ were subjects of Denmark (in personal union) during the era of the Kalmar Union, as seen most notably in Europa Universalis 4. The ⟦3⟧, The ⟦4⟧ and the ⟦5⟧ may still be formed after forming Scandinavia.
Upon doing so, such states become cores and the country gains a blue color.
Not to be confused with the Pan-Slavic Union, a formable nation available for ⟦0⟧

The Slavic Union is a formable nation, that can be formed by choosing Anastasia Romanov as the king and going down the subpath of ⟦0⟧ in the ⟦1⟧ branch as ⟦2⟧. This path gives focuses to annex ⟦3⟧ and "Annex" war goals against ⟦4⟧ and the ⟦5⟧. ⟦6⟧ can still form ⟦7⟧ and has access to the relevant focus, allowing it to get cores on Lithuania and Latvia. It is advised to finish the ⟦8⟧ focus before ⟦9⟧, otherwise the cores on Ermland-Masuren and Königsberg will be lost.
This section covers all of the ⟦0⟧ formables that require you to be a puppet of a certain nation. The nations you are a puppet to in these formables are as follows: ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, and ⟦5⟧.

The first incarnations, are the ones that can be formed in the ⟦0⟧ branch. Make your way down to the right side of the focus tree until you get to ⟦1⟧ (The name changes deepening on what nation you are going to be puppeted). In a regular game, you will most likely be becoming a German puppet and forming ⟦2⟧. If ⟦3⟧ stops being fascist, then the focus will then see if ⟦4⟧ is fascist and will become ⟦5⟧. Then, both of them not being fascist will then look towards ⟦6⟧ if that nation is fascist and form ⟦7⟧ when France accepts your proposal of being puppeted. Lastly, if ⟦8⟧ is fascist, then you would form the ⟦9⟧.
The other incarnations are formed when the nations are ⟦0⟧. The left side of the focus tree allows you to ⟦1⟧ and then complete the focus ⟦2⟧, which forms the ⟦3⟧ as a puppet of France.
⟦0⟧ can be formed by being a puppet of ⟦1⟧.

These formable nation are both available through ⟦0⟧'s path, wherein Sweden voluntarily becomes a puppet of ⟦1⟧. At the end of this path, the player has the choice to either rebel and break free to become the independent fascist nation The New Order, or stay loyal to their overlord and become Reichsprotektorat Nordland.

In order to form either of these nations, player first needs to go down the fascist sub-branch starting with the focus ⟦0⟧. This focus starts a civil war and turns the player into a puppet of Germany, called ⟦1⟧. At the end of this path the player has a mutually exclusive choice for the future of Sweden.

If the player wishes to declare independence and form The New Order, they need to complete the focus ⟦0⟧ at the end of this focus branch. This will make the player independent, add heavy tank technologies to the nation and white peace them out of all of their overlords current wars if the focus ⟦1⟧ was completed. Germany also gets a wargoal against The New Order for rebelling.

If the player wishes to stay loyal to their overlord as a puppet nation, they need to complete the focus ⟦0⟧ at the end of this focus branch. This focus will give the newly established Reichsprotektorat Nordland claims on land in northeastern Europe. Additionally, if this land is controlled by their overlord it will be transferred to Reichsprotektorat Nordland.

The ⟦0⟧ is the greater state that ⟦1⟧ tried to form during WWI and WWII. Historically, it represents a restoration of the Bulgarian Empire, which existed in 681-1018 and 1185-1396/1422. These two "Bulgarian Empires" are usually not treated as separate entities but rather as the one and same state restored after a period of foreign rule, so that technically means that the Third Bulgarian Empire is indeed a restoration of the Bulgarian Empire of old.
This formable nation is available as part of the monarchist restoration path for the ⟦0⟧, which is a rather difficult and complicated affair.

In order to form ⟦0⟧, the player must first restore the ⟦1⟧. The journey to that begins by completing the national focus ⟦2⟧. From here, the player must begin organizing, arming and equipping the Russian White Exiles while undermining the Soviet Union from within, with the intent of instigating a Second Russian Civil War to overthrow the communist Bolsheviks for good. This is the hardest path in the Soviet Union's focus tree, harder than any other branch, as the Soviet Union will have a massive military and industrial advantage over the Whites. The Whites must make intelligent use of their limited resources, subversive activities as well as whatever foreign aid they can acquire, and can even attempt to invite ⟦3⟧ to join the Soviet Civil War directly in exchange for the elimination of a rival power to their northwest, major territorial gains on the Pacific coast, and even the installation of a subject regime in the power vacuum their rival’s collapse would create.
If, against all odds, the Russian White Exiles emerge victorious, the ⟦0⟧ that fell in 1917 will be restored and a new Tsar will be crowned in Moscow.

Regardless of whether the player chooses the Monarchist branch (⟦0⟧) or the Fascist branch (⟦1⟧) of the Russian Empire's national focus tree, further down the tree lies a national focus named ⟦2⟧, which references to the notion of Moscow and, by extension, Russia, being seen as the third incarnation of the Roman Empire (With the ⟦3⟧ being the first and ⟦4⟧ being the second, respectively) and gives claims on all of the three Romes (Rome in ⟦5⟧, Istanbul/Constantinople in ⟦6⟧ and Jerusalem controlled by the ⟦7⟧).
The Rightful Heir to the Empire

By emphasizing the role of the church in the new nation, the church and state can be brought closer and closer to each other, culminating in the elevation of Metropolitan Meletius of Harbin and Manchuria to Arch-Patriarch of Moscow and All Russia and Tsar of Russia as well, effectively turning Russia into a theocracy. In line with its stated lineage to the Roman Empire, the name "Russia" will be dropped from use altogether and the nation will simply be renamed as literally ⟦0⟧, with a new flag and an imperial purple color to boot.

Should the ⟦0⟧ be dismantled for whatever reason, then one of the releasable successor states in the South Caucasus can decide to pick up the pieces of the fallen union and save what still can be saved by forming a united ⟦1⟧ to prevent the area from falling under foreign influence. The nation could be considered a restoration of the briefly-existing Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic and its Soviet successor, the Transcaucasian Socialist Federative Soviet Republic. In order to form Transcaucasia, the lands of its three core members - ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧, all ruled by the ⟦5⟧ at the start of the game - must be controlled. After formation, Transcaucasia can be expanded south into ⟦6⟧ and ⟦7⟧ to encompass traditional Azeri and Armenian territories, as well as north into the North Caucasus. Additional decisions exist to create a puppet ⟦8⟧ if the area is controlled, and a Non-Aligned or Fascist Transcaucasia has further decisions to release puppets of the ⟦9⟧ and ⟦10⟧.
Germany has decisions that allows them to form a Transcaucasian satellite state under Georgia. These decisions are unlocked when Germany completes the focus ⟦0⟧.
⟦0⟧ also has access to more decisions that give this ⟦1⟧ satellite the northern Caucasus that it will core.
